title: A tour and night to remember !!!!
text: Thank you Carlos, Laura and Letango team for making this tour a memorable one! Carlos made sure we were not too disappointed when tickets to Alhambra were sold out, he quickly came up with a back up tour that included a walk through the old city as well as wonderful information provided by our tour guide Laura!  To top the evening off Carlos went out of his way to get us a dinner reservation at  Las Tomas With a spectacular view of Alhambra in the evening. title: Private Alhambra Tour with Laura
text: My family and I went on a private tour with  our guide Laura. She was an absolutely amazing guide. She was super friendly and knowledgeable. It was super helpful to have this guide as she showed us the most important sections and allowed us to see everything in a timely manner. Would recommend it and Laura to everyone, definitely would do it again!
author: Sightseer60642851361
